title: The error log · GATE 4
objective: No new grammar except a short lower-B2 layer. Sort the error log by frequency, drill the top ten. Gate 4 — the last calm decision point.
tasks: Error log: sort by frequency, take the top ten, build a drill for each

steps.title: The highest-return week — if the log exists
steps.body: Open your **Error log**, sort by frequency, take the **top ten**. For each: write the rule in five words and five fresh sentences using it correctly. Say them aloud.

steps.title: Drill your #1 error
steps.task: Copy your most frequent error from the log. Write the rule, then five new correct sentences that use it.
steps.prompt: Mon erreur la plus fréquente : … Règle : … Cinq phrases :

steps.title: The lower-B2 layer — and no further
steps.body:
**Conditionnel passé**: *j'**aurais dû** · il **aurait fallu** · on **aurait pu***
**si + plus-que-parfait** (one or two patterns): *Si j'**avais su**, je **serais venu**.*
**Mise en relief**: *Ce qui me frappe, c'est … · C'est … qui …*
**Concession**: *même si* (+ indicative) · *bien que* (+ subjunctive)
**Hedging**: *Il me semble que … · Dans une certaine mesure … · Cela dépend de …*

items.q: Si j'avais su, je ___ plus tôt.
Même si c'___ difficile, je continue.

options: Il me semble que, dans une certaine mesure, le télétravail isole.
Le télétravail isole toujours tout le monde.

steps.title: Hedging scores. Absolutes don't.
steps.body: A nuanced position reads as **B2**; a flat one reads as **B1** however correct the grammar.

steps.title: Gate 4 · the last calm decision point
steps.body:
Pass: **CO ≥ 458, CE ≥ 453** on a **timed** mock · EE tâche 2 at **10/20** · EO tâche 3 **sustained**.
**One ability short: continue. Two or more: defer to April.**
⚠️ Re-marking of speaking/writing is suspended for sessions from 1 Sep 2026 — there is no appeal behind this rule.

points: Top-ten errors → rule + five sentences each
